integrity: The exact four-point occupancy calculation and cubic inversion are proved in RESULT.md; verify.py independently checks exact rational edge patterns and continuous-point convex hulls. Classical facet occupancy is credited as prior background.
scientific_limitations: The population probabilities are exact; finite-repetition confidence intervals, stability near repeated roots, extensions to nonsimplicial polygons, and independently adjudicated historical priority are not established.
title: Four-sample vertex-count tomography of Euclidean triangles
